text: Cruden 2 is LGC Holdco’s sole manager; the proxy distinguishes management arrangements from Lachlan Murdoch’s narrower appointment rights.
does_not_establish: The proxy expressly states that Lachlan Murdoch does not control LGC Holdco. His appointee has one of three votes for most entity-level matters; Lachlan cannot alone authorize or unwind the LGC share pledge. Share-voting and disposition powers must not be generalized to entity-wide control.

source_locators.locator: Printed pp 22–23 and 73–74; security ownership footnotes (c), (e), (g)

text: Lachlan Murdoch can appoint or replace the Cruden 2 managing director who generally decides voting and disposition of the News Corp shares, subject to specified exceptions.
does_not_establish: The appointment right concerns qualified share-voting and disposition decisions. The proxy says Lachlan Murdoch does not control LGC Holdco and cannot alone enter or unwind its pledge. He disclaims beneficial ownership, although the proxy describes deemed beneficial ownership under securities rules.
